sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official nonmember use and individual remote copy exclusion
sources.quality_notes: Official library page: individual direct remote copy request not accepted; route via domestic public/academic library; nonmember research visit separate and subject to item restrictions. No G23:12/G23:194 original folio or copy eligibility established.

sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official ILL policy for domestic university and public libraries
sources.quality_notes: Official ILL: NACSIS-ILL participating libraries and public-library copy-only route, no individual direct application; rare/semi-rare material may need contractor digital capture and separate consent; exact G23 item shelf type is unknown.
